CodeCatalyst

We made a fake Claude Pro giveaway.

Students scan the QR code, tap to claim the gift, and download a text file. When they open it, they find out what happened and get a friendly welcome to our security workshop.

Built with Next.js Downloads a real .txt file No personal data
Quick safety note. The code is fake, and the downloaded file is only text. We collect no personal information, just anonymous scan and click totals. When students open the file, it explains the trick and welcomes them to the workshop.

Desktop walkthrough

Here's how the trick works

These are screenshots of the working app, from the poster to the downloaded file.

01

Start here

Scan the poster

The poster offers a free month of Claude Pro to the first 50 K-8 students. Its QR code opens the claim page.

POST/api/scancounted when the page opens

02

Next

Tap to get the code

The claim page looks like the giveaway. Students see a free month, a $0 price, and one button.

POST/api/phishedcounted when “Get my code” is tapped

03

Then

Download the gift code

After the tap, confetti pops and a text file appears. The page still looks like a normal giveaway.

FILEclaude-pro-giftcode.txtmade in the browser

04

Last step

Open the file

The file is saved to the device. The page asks students to open it, and the surprise stays hidden until they do.

FILEclaude-pro-giftcode.txtmade in the browser

Inside the download

The message in the file

Opening claude-pro-giftcode.txt reveals the lesson right away. It also points students to the workshop.

claude-pro-giftcode.txt
==============================
       CLAUDE PRO GIFT CODE
          1 MONTH FREE
==============================

Gift code: CPRO-8K7M-2Q4P

Wait... that isn't a real code.

Yep, you just got phished by CodeCatalyst. 🎣

You scanned a QR code for a free gift and
downloaded a file from it. A real scam can
use the same trick to put something harmful
on your device.

You're safe here. This file is only text.
We didn't collect any personal info. We only
